sentences.text: It is submitted that serious prejudice would be caused to the appellant in case the stay on the operation of the impugned judgment is not granted.

Learned counsel for the appellant, on instructions, undertakes that the appellant shall deposit the entire compensation amount awarded by the learned Tribunal, alongwith the interest from the date of filing of the claim petition filed before the learned Tribunal.
Hence, she prays for grant of interim relief of stay on the operation of the impugned award.

3. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant.
4.

In regard to the prayer of the appellant with respect to the interim relief, this Court is of the view that the instant matter requires consideration and, prima facie, the balance of convenience lies in favour of the appellant.

5. Therefore, subject to the deposition of the entire compensation amount awarded by the learned Tribunal, alongwith the interest from the date of filing of the claim petition, before the Registrar General of this Court within six weeks from today, the operation of the impugned award dated 5th August, 2024 shall be kept in abeyance till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.

6. Issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes on appellant filing PF within a week.
7.
Notice is accepted by learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no.1.
8. Parties are directed to file written arguments within six weeks.
9. List on 9th December, 2024.
